title: Generate all valid IP addresses
statementMd:
Given a string of digits, return all valid IPv4 addresses that can be formed by inserting three dots (parts 0-255, no leading zeros), sorted.

**Example:** `restore_ips("25525511135")` returns `["255.255.11.135", "255.255.111.35"]`.
hints: Try 1 to 3 digits for each of four parts.
